verdict.rationale: An agent SaaS product could plausibly publish a developer API reference, so the axis applies. However, the runtime probe found no public Grok Bot API, and the only OpenAPI spec at docs.x.ai covers xAI's separate model REST API with zero grok-bot paths. Grok Bot is driven only through its own apps, so there is no evidence of an interactive API reference or runnable examples for this product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
